Translating

The translated character sheets are made possible by volunteers.

How it works

There are too many pages to expect one person to translate all of them, so this is a team effort. We care about the consistency and quality of the translations, and many of the labels are repeated, so volunteers don't edit pages directly.

Instead there's a website where volunteers can work together. Instead of whole pages, they translate line by line. Volunteers can enter alternative translations, and vote for which they prefer.

How to volunteer

If you'd like to help out, send me a message - on this site, or on Discord or Facebook.
